checkpoint_rules: Each checkpoint stores state delta and parent hash/baseline IDs, not a duplicate of all technical canon.
Changing a checkpoint invalidates descendants, not siblings/earlier ancestors.
Changing PREWAR/WARSTART upstream canon creates a new WARSTART baseline and invalidates all wartime descendants unless explicitly revalidated.
Changing only an evidence citation without changing runtime value does not invalidate descendants.
A technical index version change requires impact analysis by changed entry IDs and event relevance profiles; unaffected checkpoints may be revalidated rather than rerun.
